ValidationRule.description: Require 'Session Display Name' & 'Primary Subject Area Interest' when 'Include in Dynamic Session Field' is checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( Include_in_Dynamic_Session_Field__c )), Include_in_Dynamic_Session_Field__c = true, OR( ISBLANK( Session_Display_Name__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT(Primary_Subject_Area_Interest__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete Session Display Name & Primary Subject Area Interest fields
